responsibility: This include file adapts the shared degree-valued trigonometric implementation template from libgfortran for use inside the Fortran front end’s compile-time simplifier. By defining MPFR-based types and macro hooks for SIND, COSD, and TAND—including special exact handling such as cosd(30)=sqrt(3)/2—it generates the constant-folding helpers that simplify those intrinsics on front-end MPFR values rather than runtime scalars.
